proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B T Q hA hB hT hs h
  refine EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isTangentAt_of_dist_sq_eq_power hT ?_
  have hQ : Q ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] := by
    have := hs.wbtw.collinear
    have hne := hs.ne_right.symm
    have hAB : A ≠ B := hs.ne_right
    exact this.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB
  have hout : s.radius ≤ dist Q s.center := by
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have hcol : Collinear ℝ ({A, Q, B} : Set P) := by
      rw [Set.insert_comm]; exact hs.wbtw.collinear
    have hb := EuclideanGeometry.sbtw_of_collinear_of_dist_center_lt_radius hcol hA hlt hB hs.ne_right
    have h1 := hb.wbtw.dist_add_dist
    have h2 := hs.wbtw.dist_add_dist
    have h3 : Q ≠ A := hs.ne_left.symm
    have h4 : 0 < dist Q A := dist_pos.mpr h3
    rw [dist_comm A Q] at h1
    linarith [dist_nonneg (x := A) (y := B)]
  rw [h, EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mul_dist_eq_power_of_radius_le_dist_center (s.radius_nonneg_of_mem hA) hQ hA hB hout]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B T Q : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → T ∈ s → Sbtw ℝ Q A B → dist Q T ^ 2 = dist Q A * dist Q B → s.IsTangentAt T line[ℝ, Q, T]
